units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:2:3">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ</cite> top <he>את אסור בתַעֲרוּבָתָן</he> (not <he>אוסר</he>) thou art forbidden to wear them (wool and linen) when they are mixed (woven together).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 2:3:7">Y. Ḥall. II, end, 58ᵈ</cite> <he>דבר שהוא מקפיד על תַּעֲרוּבָתוֹ</he> a thing about the mixing of which he is particular (which he does not care to have mixed with something else).
<cite ref="Pesachim 30a:3">Pes. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>על ידי ת׳</he> in a mixture, opp. <he>בעיניה</he> in its natural state; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="V00794"><he>תַּעֲרוּבוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:2:3">Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>מי ת׳</he> mixed waters (not pure well water).
Y. Yoma I, 38ᵈ bot. מפני הת׳ to avoid mixing up (of the moneys); (Y. Shek. VI, end, 50ᵇ sing.); a. e.
